officialSources.observation: Official OyoGISS page describes state spatial-data and land-management services and says properties in all 33 LGAs were digitized and assigned property reference codes; no public parcel API is exposed in the bounded page review.
Official Oyo State Lands property-search page links to a property databank and describes its procedure; owner/legal-status fields were not requested or retained.
Official Oyo report lists OGBOMOSHO SOUTH and OGBOMOSHO NORTH property enumeration entries and identifies the state lands ministry; no parcel geometry is exposed.
Official federal cadastral/legal-survey and cadastral-GIS function context, not an Ogbomosho public parcel service.
Official NGSA index lists topographic Sheet 222: Ogbomosho; topographic coverage is not cadastral parcel geometry.
